why: `clear global` and `clearvars -global` remove global variables only (doc 'clear', 'clearvars'; MATLAB R2026a: `clearvars -global -except gz` keeps the non-global `q`, `clear global xa*` the non-global `xa1`, `clear global -regexp ^xb` the non-global `xb2` and removes the global `xb3`). So the caller's `q(2)`, `xa1(2)`, `xb2(2)` index the script's variables (dormant rows: no call out of the index), and `xb3(2)` calls `xb3.m`.
